example.title: InterContinental The Clement Monterey (2008), 750 Cannery Row

brief: A 2008 waterfront hotel in cannery style: four storeys of grey-green and cream lap siding with white-framed windows, a glazed skybridge over the street lettered with its name, and a bay wing standing on concrete piles over the rocks. Two photos. Bay-wing piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
